scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text:
In this highly competitive society, we must be different in order to survive!
I only refine equipment at the +6 ~ 12 levels.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text:
I will need ^ff9999Blessed Oridecon^000000 for weapons, and ^ff9999Blessed Elunium^000000 for armors.
Failed refines ^FF0000will not break or reduce the refine level^000000.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: How about it? Do you want to refine?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: I'm a blacksmith, not a hairstylist.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: With my hammer, I will make you a star of the sky.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Making artificial hands is not my specialty.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Bring out the item so I can refine it!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Where is this weird smell coming from?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Where is the accessory?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: What do you want me to refine?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Huh? What do you want me to do?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: This item cannot be refined.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: This equipment has refined to {0}. I only handle items with refine levels from +6 to +12!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text:
This {0} has been refined to {1}. To refine it, I need {2} and a {3} zeny refining fee.
Do you want to proceed?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: I am busy, don't joke with me!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: This {0} has been refined many times. Although it will not disappear upon failure, the {1} will disappear!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Of course, the refining fee will not be returned! Do you want to continue?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Good. I'd be sad if it failed, too.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text:
Materials insufficient.
To refine a level {0} {1}, I need {2} and a {3} zeny refining fee.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Tac! Tac! Tac!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Hahahahahaha!!!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Refine was a huge success~ Hahaha!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Oh my goodness!!!!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: Oh! Although it was blessed by {0} to retain the equipment...

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Dister
scripts.text: My mood is worse when I fail!!
